newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to tender 10-yr 7.45 pct govt notes on April 28.
newsitem.headline: HK to tender 10-yr 7.45 pct govt notes on April 28.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said on Monday it will tender its third issue of 10-year Exchange Fund Notes on April 28.
The HK$500 million notes carry a coupon of 7.45 percent per annum, with interest payable semi-annually in arrears.
The notes will mature on April 30, 2007.
An additional HK$100 million will be held as reserves by the HKMA for supply to market makers in the secondary market.
Settlement will take place on April 29, 1997, the HKMA said.
